# Comparator tests

Tests for a custom comparator, in the file beside its comparator file (`X.comparator.test.yaml` for `X.comparator.yaml`), never part of the comparator or its digest. Each case gives two extractions and states what the comparator must make of them: partial expectations (step order, steps, changes, counts, metadata, or the error the comparator must fail with) and an optional snapshot of the whole comparison. `projections check` runs them. See docs/contracts.md, "Comparator tests". The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparator-tests/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/comparator-tests/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/comparator-tests/v0.json).

## Document

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | string |  | Editors: `# yaml-language-server: $schema=<url>` at the top of the file works too. |
| `format` | `"projections.comparator-tests"` | Yes |  |
| `version` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `options` | object |  | Comparator options for every case without its own; without either, a projection's own options. |
| `cases` | array of [`case`](#case) | Yes | At least 1 item. |

No other properties are allowed.

## Definitions

### `id`

A change ID, or an item ID naming the changes whose `before` or `after` includes it.

Type: string. At least 1 character.

### `case`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Yes | Unique within the file: the case's ID. At least 1 character. |
| `before` | [`source`](#source) | Yes |  |
| `after` | [`source`](#source) | Yes |  |
| `options` | object |  | Comparator options for this case, replacing the file's. |
| `expect` | [`expect`](#expect) |  |  |
| `snapshot` | string |  | A JSON file, relative to the test file, holding the whole comparison (sorted keys, two-space indentation). `projections check --update` writes it. Pattern `^(?![/\\])(?![A-Za-z]:)[^\\]*$`. At least 1 character. |

No other properties are allowed.

### `source`

An extraction: a fixture file (an extraction, or a saved `projections.extraction` document) relative to the test file, written inline, or the projection extracted at a revision (`working-tree` for the working tree) with the working tree's definition.

Type: string or object or object or object.

### `expect`

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `order` | array of [`id`](#id) |  | Each listed change or item is in a strictly earlier step than the next. At least 2 items. |
| `steps` | array of object |  | Every step, in order; each lists only what it checks. |
| `changes` | array of any or any |  | Each selects exactly one change, by `item` or `id`, and checks the fields it lists. |
| `count` | object |  |  |
| `count.changes` | integer |  | At least 0. |
| `count.steps` | integer |  | At least 0. |
| `metadata` | object |  | A subset of the comparison metadata: objects match on the keys they list, arrays and scalars exactly. |
| `error` | string |  | The comparator must fail with a message containing this text. A case expecting an error checks nothing else. At least 1 character. |

No other properties are allowed.
